Oliver — thanks for flagging this. Good catch.

Short answer: yes, the EU DST shift (end of March) will move CET -> CEST and that changes the hour offset to SGT by one hour for sessions that straddle that boundary. That can create uncomfortable late-evening / post-midnight times for APAC attendees.

I'm attaching a simple timezone grid (timezone-grid-ceu-apac.png) and a draft agenda (clockfare-demo-agenda.pdf) to help. Two quick options we usually use:
- Keep a single live session but choose a time that's a reasonable overlap (e.g., 08:30 CET / 15:30 SGT) — tradeoff: earlier for EU leaders.
- Run a split approach: a concise EU-focused live walkthrough at a convenient EU hour and an APAC-focused session (live or recorded) at a convenient APAC time.

If you can share which stakeholders must attend live (sales execs / security / engineering), I'll coordinate on our side. Marissa / Karthik — can we try the split option first? If we do two shorter sessions we can reduce churn and avoid a late-night full audience.

Priya
